method: Opened all 70 native-pixel contact sheets across the initial and corrected sweeps, covering every visual/state at both viewport widths. Images were composed without scaling; the image viewing tool may fit large sheets on screen. Checked meaning, visible state selection, labels, wrapping, columns and captions against authored data. Final native sheets were regenerated after corrections; unchanged diagrams were not all manually reopened. Generic fixes and all nine phone states in the five spacing-corrected visuals were explicitly rechecked in final captures. The final automated sweep covers all 256 cases.
scopeLimits: Desktop light and phone dark are paired cases, not all viewport/theme combinations.
Element captures may exceed viewport height; page scrolling is expected.

Tables are intentionally scrollable; 79 additional scroll-position images retain the right columns. All desktop table content and representative phone scroll positions were manually inspected; all authored cell strings and scroll geometry were checked automatically.
This pass does not cover enlarged-dialog keyboard interaction, screen-reader output, video playback, full study flows or actual Databricks execution. Separate root-owned tests cover app interactions.

findings.description: The screen-reader helper was visibly duplicated beside arrows. Root changed its class to the existing visually-hidden utility; the final full sweep verifies one-pixel absolute helpers.
Contained phone tables scrolled but did not announce additional columns. Root added an overflow-only hint with keyboard guidance; every overflowing table state has the hint in the final sweep.
Authored spacing errors in SQL latency, UC transfer and ML target/fit/lifecycle visuals were corrected together with text equivalents. Five visuals / 18 state-viewport cases were recaptured.
